entities.summary: Prince Mihail R. Sturdza was a Romanian nobleman, diplomat and convicted war criminal. He was a descendant of the wealthy and influential Sturdza family of Romanian landowners, politicians and boyars, and played a brief role in Romanian interwar politics.
